title: The Silver Bangle
subtitle: Ding dong, cling clang. These sounds always come at such inopportune times.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Hurry up, Ajar! Bring those guys, too! Take the tuk tuk to the train station. Here are a few spots in my caravan!

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Yes, Boss!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: No, wait. Where's Sherjah! What took her so long? Wasn't she with you?

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: She ... I saw her went to the other side of the village.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Over there? I remember that's ...

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Tsk!

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Sir, please, please trust me.
She wobbles her head while begging with sincerity.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: You have to convince your father. It's not like before.

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: *sighs* Sherjah, it's not that I don't want to talk to my father.
He bends over to place the candle before the stairs, lining it up neatly with the other candles.

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: You have come to me ... I don't know, so many times. Father has already scolded me several times for letting Jina learn all those unorthodox stuff from you.

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: You know, those human books ...
His eyebrows furrow, and his face grows red with anger.

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: You can see, even Jina's mother has no help in the kitchen now. I even have to prepare the candles for Dīpa Festival myself!

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: No matter what you say, I'm not taking your advice this time. You'd better leave before my father comes out. You know how mad he gets when he sees a human.

items.speaker: Takal
items.text: Hey Rajesh, who are you talking to? You, you again?!

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Sir, please listen to me. It's an emergency. I can't tell you the details now, but in a word, this village is going to be destroyed by meteorites! You and your family need to leave here now.

items.speaker: Takal
items.text: Enough! You've played that trick a dozen times. We know what you are up to! Trying to get us out of this place? No way!

items.speaker: Rajesh
items.text: Please, Father. You know Sherjah has been ...

items.speaker: Takal
items.text: I am talking to her! Leave now, or I'll ...
The old man snatches the broom from next to the door.
No one pays attention to the running steps coming from afar.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Punji! Stop him!

items.speaker: Punji
items.text: Hiss!

items.speaker: Takal
items.text: Oh, oh, ah! Who are you, kid? Why ... why are you on human's side?

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: What, who else should I help if not her? You? An ungrateful old pig?
Kanjira squeezes in between them and confronts the old villager, like an upright snake ready to attack.

items.speaker: Takal
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: How many times has Sherjah helped you, and how many things did Jina learn from her? You! You only know being mean to her and talking about something like arcanists and humans!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Stay if you like! Sherjah is being so nice and saving your life, but no one is clever enough to listen! Better let the star fall on you and crush you into ashes!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Let's go!

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: I'm so sorry. She ...

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Aah!
Without saying another word, Kanjira seizes Sherjah's arm and drags her away.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira, stop! Don't pull me! It hurts.
Kanjira makes a sudden stop. Her chest is pumping up and down out of anger.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: They is always mean to you and bullying you! Why you must look for trouble?

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira ...

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: After all the things you do for them, how can they treat you like that?! Just leave them alone! Come with me. I still have your spot on my caravan.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: The time for entering and exiting the trains of the station is the same every day! I remember it well. There will be a train leaving here soon. There is still time.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira, take a deep breath and listen to me.
Sherjah becomes conscious of her student's emotions. She bends down to the level of Kanjira's eyes, shaking her arms to reassure her.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: I know you said all those things to them for me, and I appreciate that.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: But think about it, if I treat them just the same way they treated me, just stand by and watch them head to death ...
Sherjah chooses her words carefully, as patient as she used to be in every English class.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Even if I'm doing this out of understandable fury, how would it make me any different to them?

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Volunteering to help you, and, in your opinion, "risking my life to save them" ... They are all out of my own will.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Hatred doesn't end itself, Kanjira. It has to be ended by someone.
Kanjira stares at her teacher's face in confusion. Slowly, she lowers her eyes and looks down at her feet.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: I, I don't understand.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Do I ... Do we mean nothing to you?

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: How come?! What gave you such an idea? You are my most precious children. All of you are my treasures!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: This is not the first time you prefer they over we.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: You always put they first when there's a problem.
She knows well that Sherjah should not be blamed for this.
But this doesn't relieve her of the bitterness.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira ...

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: I, I am not able to read, but I'm not a kid now. If I can, I don't want to be an arcanist too, so me, you, and Ajar is the same.
They have no time for this.
Kanjira struggles to choke back the tears.
But she's overwhelmed by the fear of losing Sherjah.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira. Don't cry, Kanjira.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: So you've been thinking ... Oh, little one. You're just like us! We are your family!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: No, you don't understand, Ms. Sherjah. Enough talk. Maybe I don't understand any of your lectures, but you can't stay here!

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: I'm sorry, Kanjira.
Sherjah has never found it so difficult to refuse someone.

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: I have to admit they're unreasonable, but as I said, we should put that aside now. It's a matter of life, Kanjira. I can't ...
Kanjira feels her stomach churning due to the bitterness, urging her to act on impulse.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: You ... you is not listening to me at all!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Fine! Be a savior and go! We'll leave here on our own!

items.speaker: Ms. Sherjah
items.text: Kanjira!
Sherjah's hand only lands on empty air. Kanjira runs away and disappears from her sight.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: *sobbing*
She leans on the steering wheel, sobbing.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: I, I'm never talking to her again!
The caravan stops at the train station, which seems out of place in the small village.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ajar! Uncle Sinha!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Hmm. Where are they? Why is here so quiet? It was crowded this morning.
*ooze*

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: This, this is ...

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: UGGGHHHH!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Blood, so much blood ...
The terrifying masked monsters are staggering among the stone pillars in the train station.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: No! Ajar!! Uncle Sinha!!

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Hey! Boss! Over here. It's safer here. Come over!
A smart head pokes out from behind the pillar.
She quickly sneaks through the station on tiptoe without being noticed.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Whoa, I was almost scared to death! Good to see you safe. What happened here?

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: No idea! A bunch of dreadful people suddenly showed up. Each of them has a mask on their face. Over there, on the platform. There are a few more!

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: They came out of nowhere and attacked the passengers for no reason.
Ajar seems to be thinking of something. He can't help but shiver.

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: But luckily, the villagers had been evacuated before they came. Thanks to Ms. Sherjah's efforts.

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: We were left behind because we had to wait for you. Did you come here on your own? Where's Ms. Sherjah?

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: She ...

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Quiet. They're coming!

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Don't, don't let them see you.
As he shrinks in fear, something drops out of his pocket.

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Ah! D**n, my silver ...
Tonk.
A silver bracelet bounces briskly on the floor.
The slight noise is thundering in the quiet station.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Really?! You have to take those goods with you now?!

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: AAARRRHHHH!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: RUN!!

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: EEERRRHHHH!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ajar, watch out!! Ah!

items.speaker: Ajar
items.text: Boss!
A sharp rune grazes Kanjira's shoulder, leaving a deep wound.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ah ...! It hurts so much! Punji, bite them!

items.speaker: Punji
items.text: Sssss!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Go hide in the caravan! I can handle this. Ah!
Another rune flashes across her ankle. Kanjira loses her balance and falls to the ground.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Ah! It hurts.

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Oh, no, I'm dead for sure.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Pafisto Pecise!

items.speaker: Kanjira
items.text: Hmm?
As Kanjira looks up, the first thing that comes to her tearful, blurry sight is a head with milky blonde hair.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: *pants* Phew! So glad I caught up in time.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: There are people over here! Let's take her first.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: This place is soon going to be dangerous. I know a place. It's close to here. Come, take them this way!

items.speaker: Manus Disciple
items.text: UGGGHHHH!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Humph, you dirty, filthy, less-than-elegant mugs! Matilda won't even sweat bringing you down!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: May the peace be with us!
